displayPolicy.purpose: Show privacy-safe workplace facts from verified E-9 worker experience without exposing worker identity.
displayPolicy.noEvidenceMeaning: No matching record means only that Korea Employment Passport has not yet published verified worker evidence for this company. It is not a negative finding.
displayPolicy.workerEvidenceRule: Worker-experience facts must be summarized, scoped to the experience actually reported, and never generalized as guaranteed conditions for every worker.
displayPolicy.mediaRule: Photos/videos may be published only with contributor permission, metadata stripped, and privacy review completed. Do not publish identity documents, exact dorm-room addresses, faces without permission, vehicle plates, private areas without permission, or trade secrets.
